==Dialogue==
:''"I see my reputation precedes me! You must be a lover of music like myself, or you would not have sought me out. Yes, it is I, Vasilli Lutgardis, the most renowned instrument crafter on the [[Cantha|continent]]! For did I not design the Great Organ of [[House zu Heltzer]]? Am I not the visionary that visualized the thirteen-valved thimble-horn?''

:''And yet, I cannot feel completely at ease. There are always even more magnificent instruments to be created....."''

==Trivia==
*Coincidentally, Vasilli means "instrument" in Persian-Farsi, although the technical/measurement kind, not relating to music.
